timezone_basis: source contract assumption; API event_time has no offset
timestamp_semantics: MOPS-derived disclosure date and local event clock, not market-session time
identity: sha256(ticker + event_date + event_time + normalized subject + rule_version)
duplicate_policy: deduplicate exact event identity within a response; immutable versions across runs
public_output: schema, code, counts, hashes and permitted aggregate metadata only

collection_policy.historical_backfill: explicitly approved bounded ticker/month windows only
collection_policy.reconcile: re-query prior event date; immutable upsert by document/version identity
